name: Clean Combinations
description: Measured striking sharpens your standing attacks. Grappling exchanges bypass this bonus.

name: Chain Wrestling
description: High-pressure grappling improves takedown entries, with the usual high-pace gas cost.

name: Escape Artist
description: Composed defense helps against submission attempts. It does not prevent takedowns or ground strikes.

name: Pace Keeper
effect: Save up to 1 raw gas per round
description: Reduce the first eligible ordinary measured-pace charge by one gas. Finish attempts still cost the full amount.

name: Slippery Guard
description: Patient defense improves resistance to standing attacks with any approach. Cautious pace reduces striking volume; takedowns bypass the bonus.

name: Pressure Strikes
trigger: Strike approach · high pace · standing attack
description: High-pressure striking sharpens your standing attacks. High pace still spends its full gas cost; ground exchanges bypass the bonus.

name: Intercepting Knees
trigger: Strike approach · after stopping a takedown
description: Punish a stopped takedown entry with a stronger counter. This does not improve takedown defense and does nothing if the shot lands.

name: Mat Control
description: Secure more control on the scorecards from safe grappling. Adds no damage or submission bonus; active guards still earn their control.

name: Timed Entry
description: Patient entries improve takedown attempts with any approach. It does not create extra attempts; cautious pace reduces striking volume.

name: Heavy Landing
trigger: Grapple approach · measured pace · first takedown each round
description: Your first successful throw in a round earns extra control on the scorecards. Later throws get no bonus, and failed entries earn nothing.

name: Submission Hunter
description: Improve submission attacks from top position or your back. Hunting keeps its normal gas costs and gives no standing attack bonus.

name: Combat Sambo
description: Stronger ground strikes after you land a takedown, at any pace. This does not improve takedown entries, standing strikes or submission attacks.

name: Transition Trap
trigger: Measured pace · first top submission each round
effect: +10% submission attack contest once per round
description: Improve the first submission attack from top position after a takedown each round. Does not increase attempt frequency or help attacks off your back.
